page.title: Samith the Photographer
page.intro: Wildlife and nature photography is where I slow the world down. I am drawn to quiet landscapes, patient observation, trail-side details, and the unpredictable character of animals in their own environment.
page.description: This page is a more personal corner of the portfolio: a place for hiking stories, nature notes, and an Instagram-only wall for photography updates.

story.title: What I Look For
story.body: Light, movement, weather, texture, and the short-lived moments that disappear if you rush them.

story.title: Where I Wander
story.body: Forest paths, coastlines, wetlands, mountain tracks, and any quiet place that rewards patience.

story.title: Why It Matters
story.body: Photography keeps me observant. It balances technical work with attention, presence, and a different kind of problem solving.

instagram.title: Selected Frames
instagram.description: Ten favorite frames from wildlife, nature, trails, and open-air exploring.
